THIS ANOMALY IS UNCONFIRMED AS OIL. A LINEAR SLICK WAS OBSERVED IN THE CHANDELEUR SOUND AREA OF LOUISIANA, NEAR MULTIPLE OIL FACILITIES. THE ANOMALY APPEARED DARK-TONED NEAR THE EDGES AND ALSO INCLUDED WHITE AND SILVER SHIMMERY HUES IN THE MIDDLE SECTIONS THAT INDICATED POSSIBLE THICKER OIL. ALSO, THE SLICK DID NOT TEST POSITIVE FOR VEGETATION, AND HAD A STRONG CONTRAST AGAINST THE OCEAN BACKGROUND. IT MEASURED APPROXIMATELY 6 NM IN LENGTH, AND 0.25 NM AT THE WIDEST POINT. WINDS NEAR THE TIME OF THE IMAGE WERE OUT OF THE NE AT 4 KTS. UNCERTAINTIES: MULTIPLE OIL FACILITIES WERE IN CLOSE PROXIMITY TO THE ANOMALY, AND THEREFORE, A SINGLE SUSPECTED SOURCE WAS NOT CONFIRMED. ADDITIONALLY, THE FULL EXTENT OF THE SLICK WAS NOT DETERMINED DUE TO CLOUD COVER OBSERVED, THAT OBSCURED THE SW SECTIONS OF THE ANOMALY.

Nearest City: Milwaukee, WI

Suspected Responsible Party: ADVANCED WASTE CARRIERS, INC.
Skytruth Analysis
WHILE WALKING THROUGH OUR GARAGE, ONE OF OUR EMPLOYEES DISCOVERED AN UNKNOWN SUBSTANCE ON THE GARAGE FLOOR WHERE A ROLL OFF CONTAINER HAD BEEN LOCATED. INVESTIGATION FOUND THIS MATERIAL TO BE MERCURY (BASED ON THE LAST MATERIAL IN THE ROLL OFF AND THE PROPERTIES OF THE MATERIAL). FURTHER INVESTIGATION LED TO THE DISCOVERY OF MERCURY CONTAMINATION ON THE GROUND IN FRONT OF OUR MAINTENANCE GARAGE, WHERE THE ROLL OFF HAD BEEN MOVED PENDING REPAIR. UPON THE DISCOVERY OF THE RELEASE WE SECURED THE AREAS AND CALLED NORTH SHORE ENVIRONMENTAL IN TO CLEAN THE SITE AND THE EQUIPMENT.
